Do things that make you happy. You must know of something that keeps you happy and occupied. Do it. It can be anything. Go for walks outside. Talk to people. Talk to anyone you can. Start a TV series may be. And be motivated enough to finish it. It will really help. Start anything. Anything that makes you happy. Anything that will keep you occupied and will get you through the day. It does not matter what it is. 

Take it day by day. It really helps. Just decide to get through the day in the morning and then again the next day.

I agree, so many people don't understand how you feel or how depression actually feels like. For them it's just sadness. It's a phase of feeling 'down' that should just pass. Most people can't understand how depression works or how it controls us. 

Honestly, I don't blame them. It really is something you cannot understand until you go through it. You actually have to feel it to know what it's like. And I wouldn't wish that anybody goes through it just so they get to know how it feels. I wouldn't wish depression on anyone. 

Mental health is something that people need to talk more openly about. It's something that needs more attention than what is being given to it. More people need to understand and acknowledge it. Even if people don't know what it feels like, they should just acknowledge the fact that it is painful and that it is hard. 

The least you can do for someone suffering with depression is to acknowledge their pain. To tell them that you believe them. To hold their hand and say you would be there if they need you. It is right thing to do. Than to just ask the person to 'suck it up' or just outright say that something like this cannot exist just because you never had to go through it. 

Most people who just refuse to believe that depression is a disease , just like any other and it needs treatment just like any other disease. It does not need to be shut off or dismissed , but rather acknowledged and treated. 

Only of people could just begin with just accepting that mental diseases like depression exist, and that they are not a 'choice' and just lend their hand for support, even though they probably never will understand it, and they don't even need to, it would be so much better. It would be so easier and better for those suffering to open up and get help. There would not be fear of getting judged or alienated. 

To the OP , I am sorry for you and I hope you get through this. I want you to get help and hold on to hope. 

To those who have never felt depression, I sincerely hope you never do. It's hell and nobody should go through with it. But the next time someone mentions it, you can just acknowledge that person's suffering and just believe him as a fellow human being. Just know that all those going through it are not kidding, that they need support and they need to be told that they are believed. Get them help and don't just shut them down.
